A '''galley''' was a type of aquatic vessel used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. They were [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] oar-driven vessels that the inhabitants used to cross the [[Roon Sea]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
